integrity_statement: Analytic proof and a standalone symbolic/numerical consistency checker are included. No numerical sample substitutes for the proof or for a literature comparison.
scientific_limitations: The closed formula is for sufficiently small positive seasonal amplitude and a locally attracting deterministic mean-field branch near the separated-deme state.
Global basin geometry, finite-population fixation, stochastic noise, and other rates or forcing phases are not established.
The small-amplitude upper bound is guaranteed existentially, not optimized numerically.
title: Exact adiabatic migration bias in a two-deme Moran flow
